messages:
Sanjay: Paging — svc-inference latency spike across us-west-1, lots of pages. seeing p95 ~2.5s, p99 ~6s. paging history shows 3 pages in 10m, likely noisy. anyone oncall?
IncidentBot: Incident INC-4523 created (sev3) — Condition: svc_inference_request_duration_seconds p95 > 2s. Pages sent to @oncall.
Maria K: I'm oncall, looking now. initial check: heap on gpu workers ok, but a few instances show high request queue length.
Kevin L: I'm seeing an upstream flapping fallback to smaller model which increases latency, maybe routing policy hit. router logs: 503s -> fallback.
Sanjay: Confirm customer impact? any user-facing errors or just latency?
Maria K: No widespread 5xx from hosted API, but longer tails on generation causing some request timeouts for interactive flows. I've flagged a few key customers (prod orgs) — notifying CS.
Lucy P: From an alerting perspective, this is classic alert noise + threshold sensitivity. The rule is currently aggressive (p95 > 2s, FOR 1m, severity page). we should consider tuning to reduce pages for short blips.
ObservabilityBot: Current alert rule snapshot saved to /dashboards/alerts/snapshots/INC-4523-1749990007
Kevin L: Quick mitigation idea — increase route fallback threshold or temporarily scale dedicated pool for hosted tier to absorb burst. Also enable prefix-cache warmup on a subset to reduce kv misses.
Maria K: For live mitigation I'll: 1) apply temporary autoscale to pool-3 +2 nodes (5m), 2) disable aggressive fallback for 10m, see if tail improves.
Sanjay: Good. While you do that, can we decide a post-incident tuning plan? we need a dashboard for the retro with drilldowns to traces/logs and panels for golden signals.
Kevin L: Proposed dashboard panels: p50/p95/p99 latency heatmap, request QPS, error rate (4xx/5xx), model-fallback-rate, GPU queue depth per host, kv cache hit ratio, routing decision counts. Also a panel for alert noise: pages/min over 24h. Drilldowns: clicking a host should link to traces and logs.
Lucy P: Alert tuning proposal (post-incident): change alert to:
```
ALERT HighHostLatency
  IF histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 3
  FOR 5m
  LABELS { severity="warning" }
```
Then add a second rule: sustained_high_latency (p95 > 4s for 2m) -> page. The idea: warn earlier, page only for sustained/large regressions.
Maria K: +1. Also add an annotation to the alert with link to the incident dashboard and runbook steps (scale, check fallback, rollback model).
Kevin L: I'll open the grafana dashboard PR. Plan: create new dashboard "INC-4523-retro" using folder "incidents/retrospectives". Panels: latency-over-time (stacked by model variant), host drilldown panel (table with link), alert-history panel, pages-per-hour, and cpu/gpu utilization.
Sanjay: Assignments: Maria -> ops changes (autoscale + revert fallback toggle) and add runbook annotation. Kevin -> dashboard PR + panel configs + dashboard JSON. Lucy -> update alert rules in prometheus repo with proposed thresholds and add test cases. I'll coordinate customer comms and hand off at end of shift.
Maria K: Mitigation applied: scaled pool-3 +2, disabled fallback on 3 nodes. initial p95 dropped to ~1.6s after 90s. monitoring.
ObservabilityBot: Grafana snapshot created: /snapshots/INC-4523-quickview-1749990200
Kevin L: Dashboard skeleton pushed to draft branch: refs/heads/obs/inc-4523-dashboard-draft. includes latency panels + drilldown links to traces.
Lucy P: Alert PR opened: github.com/redwood/observability/pull/312 — contains new rule with FOR=5m and two-tier severity. Added unit tests for alert noise suppression.
Sanjay: Good work. I'll do a handoff to @Lucy P at 1749990400. Lucy, please take it home and run the retro doc with panel screenshots, then we can merge alert change after one week of monitoring.
Lucy P: Taking over. Will capture panel screenshots and include guidance: how to interpret fallback-rate vs cache-hit, and recommended thresholds per region. Also will add a dashboard linked to traces/logs for quick drilldowns.
Maria K: One more note — let's add a small panel showing 'model variant fallback count' over last 24h. most noise correlated with variant B rollout spikes.
Kevin L: added as panel #7 in draft.
Sanjay: Closing live mitigation. last check p95 ~1.5s and pages stopped. leaving incident open for retro. Thanks team :thumbsup:
